Marigolds. Wet cedar shingles. Cinnamon rolls next door. Standing outside my brand-new flower shop, I catch every scent on the harbor breeze, because I can't help it. My nose is that good.

In the perfume world, they called me the million dollar nose. Then I traded the six-figure job and the big city for a fresh start in the little coastal town of Port Danby.

Now I've got a flower shop of my own, a pet crow named Kingston, a tabby named Nevermore and a street full of quirky neighbors who already feel like family.

For the first time in years, life is slow and quiet and mine.

Then one of those neighbors turns up dead...

And the gift I thought I'd left behind turns out to be the one thing that can catch a killer. While everyone else sees a crime scene, I catch the one scent that doesn't belong.

The far-too-handsome local detective, James Briggs, wants me nowhere near this case, but I've got a killer to catch.

He can warn me all he wants. I can't always help what this nose does.

Book 1 of the Port Danby Cozy Mystery Series
